settings.name: Game
settings.description: Choose the Doom arsenal and soundtrack. Applies on the next map.

settings.name: Doom WAD
settings.description: Path to DOOM.WAD. Leave empty to search your Steam libraries. Applies on the next map.

settings.name: Doom II WAD
settings.description: Path to DOOM2.WAD. Leave empty to search your Steam libraries. Applies on the next map.

settings.name: Extra fire key
settings.description: Hold this key to fire. Left mouse also fires.

settings.name: Incoming damage (%)
settings.description: Damage taken before Doom armor absorbs its share.

settings.name: Cheat commands
settings.description: Type IDDQD, IDFA, IDKFA, IDCHOPPERS, IDCLIP or IDMUS followed by two digits during gameplay.

settings.name: Fit status bar to screen
settings.description: Fit the status bar to the screen width.

settings.name: Status bar scale (%)
settings.description: Size of the status bar when Fit status bar to screen is off.

settings.name: Bilinear Doom textures
settings.description: Smooth Doom's HUD, weapons, effects and pickups. Applies immediately.

settings.name: Projectile lights
settings.description: Plasma and BFG shots light nearby surfaces. Applies immediately.

settings.name: Music
settings.description: Doom music and Off stop Dying Light's music manager while the mode is active.

settings.name: Music synthesizer
settings.description: Choose the instruments used for Doom music. Applies immediately.

settings.name: SoundFont file
settings.description: Path to an SF2 file for SoundFont music. Applies immediately.

settings.name: Default track (IDMUS number)
settings.description: Applies on the next map. Use 0 for E1M1 in Doom or MAP01 in Doom II.

settings.name: Sound volume (%)
settings.description: Volume of Doom weapons, pickups and the failed-interaction sound.
